request.question: How did revenue change between January and February, and which region and product movements offset each other?

limitations: Observed changes and accounting contributions do not establish external causation.

kpis.name: Revenue Previous Period
kpis.dax:
VAR PeriodRows = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('FactSales'), REMOVEFILTERS('DimDate'), FILTER(ALL('DimDate'), 'DimDate'[Date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1) && 'DimDate'[Date] < DATE(2026, 2, 1)))
VAR Amount = CALCULATE([Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS('DimDate'), FILTER(ALL('DimDate'), 'DimDate'[Date] >= DATE(2026, 1, 1) && 'DimDate'[Date] < DATE(2026, 2, 1)))
RETURN IF(COALESCE(PeriodRows, 0) = 0, 0, Amount)

kpis.name: Revenue Current Period
kpis.dax:
VAR PeriodRows = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('FactSales'), REMOVEFILTERS('DimDate'), FILTER(ALL('DimDate'), 'DimDate'[Date] >= DATE(2026, 2, 1) && 'DimDate'[Date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1)))
VAR Amount = CALCULATE([Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS('DimDate'), FILTER(ALL('DimDate'), 'DimDate'[Date] >= DATE(2026, 2, 1) && 'DimDate'[Date] < DATE(2026, 3, 1)))
RETURN IF(COALESCE(PeriodRows, 0) = 0, 0, Amount)

kpis.name: Revenue Change
kpis.dax:
VAR Previous = [Revenue Previous Period]
VAR CurrentAmount = [Revenue Current Period]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(Previous) || ISBLANK(CurrentAmount), BLANK(), CurrentAmount - Previous)

kpis.name: Revenue Growth %
kpis.dax:
VAR Previous = [Revenue Previous Period]
RETURN IF(Previous > 0, DIVIDE([Revenue Change], Previous), BLANK())

model.grain: One synthetic sales line; Revenue is net line revenue in VND.

limitations: DAX must be executed in Power BI before execution/reconciliation can be marked passed.
LLM-selected report layout is excluded; the flagship uses fixed deterministic visuals.
Analysis: Observed changes and accounting contributions do not establish external causation.
